overview.summary: The canary_cdash extension creates CDash XML reports, uploads results to CDash, generates HTML CDash summaries, and can derive GitLab issues from failed CDash tests.

capabilities: Create CDash Test XML files from Canary jobs.
Validate generated XML when xmlschema is available.
Post generated XML files to CDash.
Categorize failed tests as failed, diffed, or timeout.
Generate CDash links for builds and tests.
